decision.summary: Local fail-closed entrypoints remain the primary ownership boundary; GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch and post-publish mirror workflows remain optional secondary-enforcement surfaces only.

primary_owner.label: local fail-closed entrypoints
why: These surfaces define preflight and fail-closed mutation eligibility before live apply or publish occurs.
They own contract validation and continuation decisions rather than replaying an already-live state from CI.

ownership: manual replay of the shared read-only wrapper

boundary_rules: Do not describe a GitHub Actions stop or error as proof that GitHub Actions prevented publish.
Do not let workflow_dispatch become the first place where create/apply/publish invariants are enforced.
Do not widen GitHub Actions surfaces into live delegated apply while local fail-closed entrypoints remain the primary control plane.
Do preserve artifact-first failure semantics so workflow evidence survives even when a replay stops or drifts.
Do treat attribution failure as a stop-before-verifier condition, not as permission to continue with guessed ownership.
